JSON-encoded string. Audience object with `version`, `operator`, `conditions`, and optional `except`, defined by
`audienceDefinitionContract`; preserve every requested criterion, including device criteria. Null targets
everyone, an omitted value keeps the current audience on updates, and `devices` must match. Example:

types.description:
Variant settings for `abTestCreate`, `abTestAddVariants`, `abTestSaveDraft`, and `abTestUpdateVariants`.
On create and add the position
decides the role: the first variant of a test becomes CONTROL and later ones VARIANT, whatever `type` says.

inputFields.description: Descriptive text applied by `abTestUpdateVariants`; not saved during variant creation.
inputFields.name: description

inputFields.description:
JSON-encoded string. Object with `default`, a list of transforms, plus optional global `style` (CSS) and `script`
(JavaScript) strings. Each transform has a `target` CSS selector, `finalSelectors` (selectors for the element
after the change), and exactly one change such as `text`, `style`, or `attr`. Required and validated for
non-control PATCH variants when saved and at publish; ignored for controls and SPLIT tests. Full format: the
`ab-test-variant-patches` skill. Example:
{"default":[{"target":"h1","text":"New headline","finalSelectors":["h1"]}]}
inputFields.name: editorPatch

inputFields.description:
Variant id from `abTestEditorDetail` or `abTestRefList`; required by `abTestSaveDraft` and `abTestUpdateVariants`,
omitted on create and add.
inputFields.name: id

inputFields.description: Split-test redirect URL; required for every non-control variant before publication, ignored on PATCH creation.
inputFields.name: redirectUrl

inputFields.description: Ignored by create/add/update; use `abTestRetireVariant` to retire a variant.
inputFields.name: status

inputFields.description:
Required by the schema, but on create and add the position sets the role. On `abTestUpdateVariants` it sets the
role, and CONTROL clears `editorPatch`.
inputFields.name: type

inputFields.description:
Traffic percentage, truncated to tenths; no bounds or total-of-100 check. Omission in `abTestUpdateVariants`
clears the weight; omission in `abTestSaveDraft` preserves it.
inputFields.name: weight

requests must omit it, even as an empty list.

inputFields.description:
Unix seconds used only with `CUSTOM`; must not be in the past or more than three years after start.
Omission uses start plus 60 days, with current time as the unscheduled start.
inputFields.name: expiresAt

inputFields.description:
`DEFAULT` uses 60 days and 25000 visits; `CUSTOM` uses supplied `expiresAt` and `maxVisits`, with either
missing value falling back to its default.
inputFields.name: expiresAtOption

inputFields.description:
Ignored for `DEFAULT`; `URL` accepts omitted strict flags as false. `WILDCARD`, `REGEX`, `NAMED` and
`GOOGLE_OPTIMIZE` need their respective text field.
inputFields.name: matchingRule

inputFields.description:
Visit limit from 1 to the account per-snapshot cap. Used only with `expiresAtOption: CUSTOM`; omission
or `DEFAULT` uses 25000.
inputFields.name: maxVisits

inputFields.description: True uses a user-uploaded screenshot and element data instead of automatic capture; omitted means false.
inputFields.name: pageCameraSnapshot

inputFields.description:
With `pageCameraSnapshot: true`, true starts processing already uploaded files; false or omitted waits
for user files. Ignored for automatic capture.
inputFields.name: preUpload

inputFields.description:
Comma-separated CSS selector text, for example `.modal, #banner`; truncated to 1000 characters. Used
only with `REMOVE_ELEMENTS`; omitted or empty text adds no removal rule.
inputFields.name: removeElements

inputFields.description: Screenshot cleanup mode; only `REMOVE_ELEMENTS` uses `removeElements`.
inputFields.name: removeElementsOption

inputFields.description:
True requests a successor snapshot when this one reaches its date or visit limit, subject to account
eligibility; defaults to false.
inputFields.name: reoccurring

inputFields.description:
Track one in this many visits, integer 2 to 50000 when `useSamplingRatio` is true. Required by the
schema even when false, when the value is ignored.
inputFields.name: samplingRatio

inputFields.description:
Unix seconds for `SCHEDULED`; ignored for `IMMEDIATELY`. If supplied, must not be in the past or after
expiration; omission leaves the start unscheduled.
inputFields.name: startsAt

inputFields.description:
`SCHEDULED` uses `startsAt` when supplied; `IMMEDIATELY`, or a missing `startsAt`, starts without a
scheduled time.
inputFields.name: startsAtOption

inputFields.description:
Selects the matching rule type; `DEFAULT` ignores `matchingRule`, while other types use their
corresponding fields.
inputFields.name: trackingOption

inputFields.description: True applies `samplingRatio`; false ignores its required value and clears custom sampling.
inputFields.name: useSamplingRatio

inputFields.description:
True applies `waitAfterLoad` to screenshot capture; false ignores its required value and clears the
custom delay.
inputFields.name: useWaitAfterLoad

inputFields.description:
Delay after page load in seconds, clamped to 0 through 60. Required by the schema even when
`useWaitAfterLoad` is false, when the value is ignored.

inputFields.description:
JSON-encoded string with one trigger filter: an object with integer `version` 3 (legacy 2 is still accepted),
`operator` `OR` or `AND`, and a non-empty `conditions` array. Send one condition per trigger and use separate
triggers for alternatives. Each condition has `criteria`, `multiple_values` set to `or`, and a `values` array,
and never `comparison`. `goalDetail` returns existing filters in this format. Example:
{"version":3,"operator":"OR","conditions":[{"criteria":"url_visit","multiple_values":"or","values":["https://example.com/thanks"]}]}.
`url_visit` values are non-empty page URL strings. `code` values are non-empty conversion codes that the page
passes to `CE2.converted`, for example {"criteria":"code","multiple_values":"or","values":["signup"]}.
`click` and `form_submission` values are objects with strings `auto_name`, `source_url`, `selector_for_desktop`,
`selector_for_tablet`, and `selector_for_phone`, booleans `sync_selectors` and `on_any_page`, `selector_source`
(`manual` for your own CSS selectors, `specific`, or `broad`), and optional `name`, `preview_url`, and `on_page`;
form submissions also need non-empty `source_url` and selectors. Example:
{"criteria":"click","multiple_values":"or","values":[{"auto_name":"Buy","source_url":"https://example.com","selector_for_desktop":"#buy","selector_for_tablet":"#buy","selector_for_phone":"#buy","selector_source":"manual","sync_selectors":true,"on_any_page":true}]}.
`pixel_event` values are objects with boolean `on_any_page`, `api` (`google`, `tiktok`, `meta`, or `ga4`), and
optional `id` and `event`, for example {"criteria":"pixel_event","multiple_values":"or","values":[{"on_any_page":true,"api":"meta","event":"Purchase"}]}.
`ecommerce_event` values are objects with boolean `on_any_page`, `api` (`shopify`, `woocommerce`, `magento`,
`wixapi`, `squarespace`, or `generic`), and `event` (`addToCart`, `startCheckout`, or `checkoutCompleted`), for
example {"criteria":"ecommerce_event","multiple_values":"or","values":[{"on_any_page":true,"api":"woocommerce","event":"checkoutCompleted"}]}.
A Shopify `ecommerce_event` trigger is saved as an `api` trigger named after the goal. `api` triggers are created
automatically with {"criteria":"api","multiple_values":"or","values":[]}; keep one by resending its `id` and
`filter` unchanged.
inputFields.name: filter

fields.name: abTestRename

args.description: Test id from `abTestList`, `abTestRefList`, or `abTestCreate`.
args.name: id

args.description: Numeric variant id from `abTestRefList` or `abTestEditorDetail.variants`; must belong to this test.
args.name: variantId

fields.description:
Retires a non-control variant of a DRAFT or RUNNING test, keeping the variant and its results; tests saved with
`createSnapshots` also stop that variant's snapshots. Use `abTestDeleteVariant` to remove a variant from a DRAFT
instead. Without per-variant snapshots, retiring an already retired variant or one on a STOPPED test returns the
test unchanged. Request only stored fields such as `id`, `name`, and `status` in the response. Requires A/B testing
edit access.
fields.name: abTestRetireVariant

args.description: Complete draft settings and every existing variant, including its id and intended patch or redirect.
args.name: args

args.description: Existing draft test id from abTestEditorDetail or abTestCreate.
args.name: id

fields.description:
Saves settings, notes, and all existing variants of a DRAFT test in one Core database transaction, using the
normal audience validation and synchronization. Re-runs the page check and validates supplied patches before
committing. Include every stored variant exactly once with its numeric id,
keeping the control first; this operation cannot add or remove variants. Non-drafts are rejected under a
row lock. Requires A/B testing edit access. Does not publish.
fields.name: abTestSaveDraft

args.description: Whether automatic traffic reweighting is enabled; supplied manual weights are saved either way.
args.name: autoReweight

args.description: Test id from `abTestList`, `abTestRefList`, or `abTestCreate`.
args.name: id

args.description:
Existing variant ids and traffic percentages; omitted variants keep their weights and totals are not
validated.
args.name: variants

fields.description:
Sets `autoReweight` and manual traffic weights for the listed variants in any status and returns the test with
refreshed metrics. Weights are percentages stored to one decimal place and are not checked to total 100; variants
left out keep their weights. Pass an empty `variants` list to change only `autoReweight`. Requires A/B testing edit
access.
fields.name: abTestSetTrafficSplit

args.description: Test id from `abTestList`, `abTestRefList`, or `abTestCreate`.
args.name: id

fields.description:
Stops a RUNNING test and records the stop time; other statuses return an error. Tests saved with `createSnapshots`
also stop their per-variant snapshots. A stopped test cannot be restarted (`abTestDuplicate` copies it into a new
draft), and stopping it again returns it unchanged when it has no per-variant snapshots. Requires A/B testing edit
access.
fields.name: abTestStop

args.description: Draft settings; provide matching audience/devices and use variant mutations for later variant changes.
args.name: args

args.description: Test id from `abTestList`, `abTestRefList`, or `abTestCreate`.
args.name: id

fields.description:
Replaces the settings and saved `draft` of a DRAFT test; other statuses return an error and change nothing. Re-runs
the page check, which can create a missing site, checks `devices` against the audience, and queues fresh screenshots
of every variant. `variants` and `notes` in the input are not applied to the test; use the variant mutations and
`abTestUpdateNotes`. Use `abTestUpdateDraft` to save wizard progress only. Requires A/B testing edit access.
fields.name: abTestUpdate

args.description: Replacement draft metadata; variants are discarded and stored test settings are not applied.
args.name: args

args.description: Test id from `abTestList`, `abTestRefList`, or `abTestCreate`.
args.name: id

fields.description:
Saves wizard progress on a DRAFT test by replacing only its `draft` JSON; other statuses return an error. It skips
the page check and applies neither settings nor the audience to the test, but `audienceDefinition` must be valid and
`devices` must match it. Variants are dropped from the saved draft, and screenshots of every variant are queued. Use
`abTestUpdate` to apply settings. Requires A/B testing edit access.
fields.name: abTestUpdateDraft

args.description: Test id from `abTestList`, `abTestRefList`, or `abTestCreate`.
args.name: id

args.description: Replacement notes for the test; an empty string clears the saved text.
args.name: notes

fields.description:
Replaces the `notes` of a DRAFT, RUNNING, or STOPPED test; `notes` sent in legacy create or update inputs only reach
`draft`. Request only stored fields such as `id`, `name`, and `status` in the response. Requires A/B testing edit
access.
fields.name: abTestUpdateNotes

args.description: Replacement descriptive text for the variant; this does not change its patch or redirect.
args.name: description

args.description: Test id from `abTestList`, `abTestRefList`, or `abTestCreate`.
args.name: id

args.description: Numeric variant id from `abTestRefList` or `abTestEditorDetail.variants`; must belong to this test.
args.name: variantId

fields.description:
Sets one variant's `description` on a DRAFT, RUNNING, or STOPPED test without changing its patch, redirect, or
weight; use `abTestUpdateVariants` for other variant changes. The response is the updated variant record, so request
only `id`, which is the variant id. Requires A/B testing edit access.
fields.name: abTestUpdateVariantDescription

args.description: Test id from `abTestList`, `abTestRefList`, or `abTestCreate`.
args.name: id

args.description:
Each entry needs the `id` of a variant of this test, from `abTestEditorDetail` or `abTestRefList`; entries with
other ids are skipped.
args.name: variants

fields.description:
Updates variants of a DRAFT or RUNNING test, matched by `id`; ids that are not variants of this test are skipped.
Use `abTestAddVariants` to append variants. A supplied `editorPatch` is validated, an omitted `weight` is cleared,
and screenshots and per-variant snapshots of the updated variants are recaptured. Requires A/B testing edit access.
fields.name: abTestUpdateVariants

args.description: Draft inputs processed in order; earlier creates remain saved if a later input fails.
args.name: abTests

fields.description:
Creates several DRAFT tests by running `abTestCreate` on each input in order and returns them in reverse input
order. It stops at the first failure and returns only that error while tests created before it stay saved, so check
`abTestList` after an error. Requires A/B testing create access.
fields.name: abTestsCreate

args.description: Site URL or hostname; a scheme is added and the registrable domain becomes the site name.
args.name: url

fields.description:
Creates a site using the lowercased registrable domain of the URL, enabling session recording and refreshing
the tracking script. A missing scheme is added; subdomains belong to the same site, and an existing domain
returns an error. Returns the caller's full site list, sorted by name and ID. Requires sites create access.
fields.name: addSite

args.description: Numeric recording ids from `recordingsList` or `recordingsIdsInGroup`; do not pass `hashedId` or `sessionId`.
args.name: recordingIds

args.description: Tag names; each is lowercased, trimmed, and truncated to 50 characters, and duplicates are dropped.
args.name: tags

fields.description:
Adds normalized tags to the accessible recordings and returns one entry per normalized tag with the count of
recordings changed. Tags are lowercased, trimmed, truncated to 50 characters, and de-duplicated; existing tags are
not duplicated. Returns null when the session cannot change tags. Requires recordings edit access.
fields.name: addTagsToRecordings

args.description: Content, name, type, and initial activation state for the new add-on.
args.name: addon

args.description: Site ID from sites.
args.name: siteId

fields.description:
Creates a survey or CTA and returns its UUID and preview token. Send `active: false` to save an unpublished
draft, then call `addonDraftPublish` to publish it; `addonContentContract` describes `content`. Content and
audience are saved together. Requires survey create access or CTA create access matching the type.
fields.name: addonCreate

args.description: Add-on UUID from addonList or addonDetail.
args.name: id

args.description: Site ID from sites.
args.name: siteId

fields.description:
Soft-deletes an existing add-on and its attached audiences, returning its UUID. Clears related notifications
and refreshes the tracking script. Requires survey edit access or CTA edit access matching the add-on type.
fields.name: addonDelete

args.description: Add-on UUID from addonList or addonDetail.
args.name: id

args.description: Owning site ID from addonDetail; must match the add-on.
args.name: siteId

fields.description:
Clears saved draft name, content, and audience together for a previously published add-on. Leaves its
current published content and activation state in place. Requires survey edit access or CTA edit access
matching the add-on type.
fields.name: addonDraftDiscard

args.description: Add-on UUID from addonList or addonDetail.
args.name: id

args.description: Owning site ID from addonDetail; must match the add-on.
args.name: siteId

fields.description:
Publishes and enables the add-on, applying saved draft content and audience together for an already
published record. First publication uses current content and primary audience; draft fields are cleared.
Refreshes the tracking script after saving; regeneration failure can be reported after publication succeeds.
Requires survey edit access or CTA edit access matching the add-on type.
fields.name: addonDraftPublish

args.description: Add-on UUID, destination site, and fields to update; omitted fields remain unchanged.
args.name: addon

fields.description:
Updates an existing survey or CTA and returns a preview token; use the draft fields for unpublished edits
to a published add-on, then `addonDraftPublish`. Site changes are rejected after publication. Returns
`status: DELETED` when the record was already soft-deleted. Requires survey edit access or CTA edit access
matching the add-on type.
fields.name: addonEdit

args.description: Add-on UUID from addonList or addonDetail.
args.name: id

args.description: Site ID from sites.
args.name: siteId

args.description: True to enable a previously published add-on; false to disable delivery.
args.name: status

fields.description:
Changes activation of an existing add-on and returns the resulting boolean. Enabling requires prior
publication through `addonDraftPublish`; this does not publish pending draft edits. Marks a linked
suggestion used and refreshes the tracking script. Requires survey edit access or CTA edit access matching
the add-on type.
fields.name: addonEnabled

args.description: Reusable content and catalog metadata; use addonCreate to create a site add-on.
args.name: template

args.description: Optional thumbnail file upload.
args.name: thumbnail

fields.description:
Creates a reusable survey or CTA template rather than a site add-on. Templates cannot contain nonempty
audience targeting or activation URLs; an uploaded thumbnail is stored before saving. Requires add-on
template management access.
fields.name: addonTemplateCreate

args.description: Template ID from addonTemplatesList or addonTemplateDetail.
args.name: id

fields.description:
Permanently deletes a template and returns its integer ID. Use addonDelete to soft-delete a site add-on
instead. Requires add-on template management access.
fields.name: addonTemplateDelete

args.description: Template ID from addonTemplatesList plus replacement content and catalog metadata.
args.name: template

args.description: Optional replacement thumbnail upload; omit to retain the current thumbnail.
args.name: thumbnail

fields.description:
Updates a reusable template by ID without changing its type. Templates cannot contain nonempty audience
targeting or activation URLs; an optional upload replaces the thumbnail. Requires add-on template management
access.
fields.name: addonTemplateEdit

args.description:
The complete Markdown brand guidelines document, not a patch; trimmed, nonempty, at most 50,000
characters. Plain text, not JSON.
args.name: content

args.description:
Current revision from `brandGuideline`; use 0 before the first revision. A stale value returns a
revision conflict.
args.name: expectedRevision

args.description: Site ID from `sites`.
args.name: siteId

fields.description:
Creates a brand guidelines revision if `expectedRevision` matches the latest revision. Unchanged trimmed
content returns the existing revision. Prefer `siteAssetRevisionCreate` with BRAND_GUIDELINES for new
clients. Requires a logged-in session and site edit access.
fields.name: brandGuidelineRevisionCreate

args.description:
The customer's answer to the cancellation survey, sent to support as one line of at most 128
characters.
args.name: reason

fields.description:
Cancels the subscription permanently from the cancellation flow: the account moves to the cancelled plan,
not Free or Free+, and is kept rather than deleted. Paid plans keep access until the period ends; trials
cancel immediately. Contacts Stripe and notifies support; fails without a subscription, and Enterprise
plans must contact support. On a free plan, or one already cancelling, cancelled, or expired, it returns
the status without changes. Use `switchToFree` to keep a free plan. Requires billing edit access.
fields.name: cancelSubscription

args.description: Release entry ID from `changelog`, supplied as an integer; must already have been marked seen.
args.name: eventId

args.description: Reaction string saved on the current guest's view; no enum allow-list is enforced.
args.name: reaction

fields.description:
Updates the current guest's reaction on an already viewed release entry and returns that view state. Call
`viewChangelogEvents` first; a missing view cannot be created by this operation. Requires a logged-in session.
fields.name: changelogReaction

args.description: Token of the capture ticket.
args.name: token

fields.description:
Stores the two images uploaded for a capture ticket from pageThumbnails as the site's browser capture of the
page and returns its READY thumbnail. Both must be JPEGs of the device's sizes. The ticket is used up even when
the images are rejected; look the page up again for a new one. Requires an interactive session of the account
the ticket was issued to.
fields.name: commitPageThumbnail

args.description:
Nonempty list of invitee email addresses; whitespace is trimmed and duplicates are ignored
case-insensitively. Existing members or invitations are rejected.
args.name: emails

args.description:
Role to assign; `ACCOUNT_HOLDER` is treated as `OWNER` without transferring account ownership. Only an
owner can assign `OWNER`.
args.name: role

args.description:
Site names from `sites`, not numeric IDs; must be nonempty when `specificSites` is true. Owners ignore
this list.
args.name: sites

args.description:
Whether to restrict access to the listed `sites`; false grants access to all sites. Ignored for owners,
who always have access to all sites.
args.name: specificSites

fields.description:
Adds team members and returns their roster rows in submitted email order after deduplication. Existing
Crazy Egg users, and new users when SAML SSO is enabled, join immediately; anyone else gets a pending
invitation that expires after 30 days. Sends an invitation email to every address. Requires team settings
edit access.
fields.name: createAccountUsers

args.description: Site, UTC-midnight window, distinct supported features, and completion-notification email.
args.name: input

fields.description:
Creates a pending site-data export request for a UTC-midnight window of at most 90 days. Generation runs
asynchronously and a completion notification is attempted at `notificationEmail`; use `aiExport` to check status
and obtain the completed download. Requires a logged-in session, export availability, site access, and view
access to every selected feature; web analytics must be within available history. Export availability requires
JSON export access or the export-everything override. At most three AI Export
requests may be created per account in a rolling 24-hour window across all sites and team members. Accepted
requests count regardless of generation status; worker retries do not consume another request. Exceeding the
limit returns RATE_LIMITED with an extensions.retry_at UTC timestamp for the next available request.
fields.name: createAiExport

args.description:
Stripe price ID from `pricingGrid` or a tier `stripeId` from `tieredPricingPlans`; not the numeric
payment plan ID.
args.name: planPriceId

args.description: Optional referral string; currently ignored by this operation.
args.name: promotekitReferral

fields.description:
Creates a hosted Stripe checkout session and returns its URL; completing checkout purchases the plan.
Contacts Stripe and can create or link the billing customer, but fails when Stripe already holds a live or
unpaid subscription for it. Use `updateSubscriptionItems` to change an existing subscription or
`createSubscription` to pay in-app. Requires billing change plan access.
fields.name: createCustomCheckoutSession

args.description: Site, folder type, and title for the new folder; ownership comes from the current session.
args.name: folder

fields.description:
Creates a folder owned by the current account on an editable site and returns it. Supports snapshots, recordings,
A/B testing, and editor folder types; use `updateFolder` to rename a snapshots folder. Requires snapshots edit
access.
fields.name: createFolder

args.description: Non-empty list of URL/device captures; create a separate item for each screenshot device.
args.name: params

args.description: Shared settings applied to every item in `params`.
args.name: settings

fields.description:
Creates one snapshot per URL/device item using shared settings, returning IDs and names. Validation failures
prevent the entire batch and return indexed errors; successful creation may create sites and refreshes the
tracking script. Use `duplicateSnapshots` to copy existing settings. Requires snapshot edit access.
fields.name: createSnapshots

fields.description:
Creates a Stripe customer session for an embedded pricing table. Returns `clientSecret: null` without
contacting Stripe when the billing account has no linked Stripe customer; otherwise contacts Stripe to
create the session. Use `createCustomCheckoutSession` for a hosted checkout URL. Requires authentication.
fields.name: createStripeCustomerSession

args.description:
Stripe payment method ID from the client-side card form. Omit to reuse the customer's default card;
required when the account has no Stripe customer yet.
args.name: paymentMethodId

args.description:
Stripe price ID from `pricingGrid` or a tier `stripeId` from `tieredPricingPlans`; not the numeric
payment plan ID.
args.name: planPriceId

args.description: Optional referral string; currently ignored by this operation.
args.name: promotekitReferral

fields.description:
Starts an in-app Stripe subscription for the plan, or resumes or adjusts the existing one instead of
creating a second subscription. Contacts Stripe and can create the customer, set `paymentMethodId` as its
default card, or collect an outstanding invoice. New subscriptions have no trial and are charged
immediately; confirm a returned `clientSecret` to finish payment. Use `createCustomCheckoutSession` for
hosted checkout. Requires billing change plan access.
fields.name: createSubscription

args.description: Exact confirmation string `delete`.
args.name: delete

args.description: Signed-in viewer ID from `me.guestId`; it must match the current viewer.
args.name: userId

fields.description:
Deletes the signed-in account holder's account after confirming `delete: "delete"` and the viewer ID from
`me.guestId`. Cancels subscriptions, removes sites and invitations, and queues a confirmation email naming
a final deletion date 28 days later. Only the account holder can delete, and only while the plan is free
or the subscription is cancelling, cancelled, or expired; `cancelSubscription` keeps the account. Requires
account delete access.
fields.name: deleteAccount

args.description:
Unique member (`ua_`) or invitation (`i_`) IDs from `accountUsers`; the whole call fails if any row is
gone or not deletable.
args.name: ids

fields.description:
Removes members or pending invitations from the active account and returns the submitted IDs. Use rows
from `accountUsers` whose `canDelete` is true; the account holder and the caller cannot be removed.
Removal revokes account access but does not delete the user's own Crazy Egg login. Requires team settings
edit access.
fields.name: deleteAccountUsers

args.description: Crazy Egg connection id from `adPerformanceHeader` or `adsLibraryPreviewHeader` for the selected site.
args.name: connectionId

args.description: Accessible site id from `sites`.
args.name: siteId

fields.description:
Permanently deletes an ad connection and all ad data imported through it, returning its id and provider. Errors
when the connection is not on the site; find ids with `adPerformanceHeader`. Requires Ad Performance edit access.
fields.name: deleteAdPlatformConnection

args.description: Snapshots folder `id` from `folders` or `folder`; its snapshots are also soft-deleted.
args.name: id

fields.description:
Deletes a snapshots folder owned by the current account on an editable site and returns the deleted folder. Also
deletes every snapshot inside the folder and regenerates the tracking script. Requires snapshots edit access.
fields.name: deleteFolder

args.description: Positive custom playlist `id` from `playlistsList` for this site; recommended ids are not accepted.
args.name: playlist

args.description: Site id from `sites`; the site must be accessible to the current viewer.
args.name: site

fields.description:
Deletes a custom site playlist and its usage history, returning true on success. Recommended ids return a not-found
error; recordings matched by the filter are not deleted. Requires recordings edit access.
fields.name: deletePlaylist

args.description: Numeric recording ids from `recordingsList` or `recordingsIdsInGroup`; do not pass `hashedId` or `sessionId`.
args.name: recordingIds

args.description: Site id from `sites`; the site must be editable by the caller.
args.name: site

fields.description:
Soft-deletes the given recordings on an editable site so they no longer appear in recordings queries, and returns
the deleted numeric ids in `affected`. Ids the caller cannot access are skipped, and a site the caller cannot edit
returns an error. Requires recordings edit access.
fields.name: deleteRecordings

args.description: Site ID from sites.
args.name: siteId

fields.description:
Soft-deletes an editable site and returns the remaining accessible sites sorted by name and ID. Associated
data is not synchronously removed here, and the mutation requests a tracking script refresh. Requires sites
delete access.
fields.name: deleteSiteAndAssociatedData

args.description:
Snapshot IDs from `snapshotsList` or `snapshots`; inaccessible or ineligible snapshots may be
skipped.
args.name: snapshotIds

fields.description:
Marks accessible snapshots as deleted and returns their IDs. Also detaches recurring predecessors and
refreshes the tracking script; use `pauseSnapshots` to stop collection while keeping snapshots listed.
Requires snapshot edit access.
fields.name: deleteSnapshots

fields.description:
Clears both active account API credentials and returns `true` on success. A later call to `api` creates
credentials again; use `regenerateUserApiCredentials` to replace them in one call. Requires API edit
access.
fields.name: disableUserApiCredentials

args.description:
Snapshot IDs from `snapshotsList` or `snapshots`; inaccessible or ineligible snapshots may be
skipped.
args.name: snapshotIds

fields.description:
Creates copies of eligible snapshots, stops their originals, and refreshes the tracking script. Returns the
new IDs; manual captures, A/B test variants, recurring snapshots and snapshots with a recurring successor
are skipped. Use `refreshSnapshots` to recapture without creating copies. Requires snapshot edit access.
fields.name: duplicateSnapshots

args.description:
Snapshot to export side by side with the single snapshot in `snapshotIds`, as the report's compare mode
does. Only `HEATMAP`, `SCROLLMAP` and `CONFETTI` views are drawn for a comparison.
args.name: compareSnapshotId

args.description: Export date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format, for example `2026-10-20`.
args.name: date

args.description: Optional email address that receives the finished export.
args.name: destinationEmail

args.description:
JSON object of report filters to apply to the export, as the report's event filter builds them, for
example `{"beginTime":1790000000,"endTime":1790600000}`. Omit it to export all data.
args.name: filter

args.description:
Snapshot IDs from `snapshotsList` or `snapshots`; inaccessible or ineligible snapshots may be
skipped.
args.name: snapshotIds

args.description: Non-empty export view list; `AI` requires JSON export access in addition to CSV export access.
args.name: views

fields.description:
Requests exports for snapshots with data and no screenshot error, returning accepted snapshot IDs. Use
`snapshotExports` to retrieve download URLs; an empty result means none qualify, and `destinationEmail`
requests email delivery. Requires CSV export access, plus JSON export access when `views` includes `AI`.
fields.name: exportSnapshots

args.description:
For `REDIRECTED`, the URL the page ended on, as the capture page reported it. Kept only when it is an
absolute HTTP(S) URL of at most 2048 characters; ignored for other reasons.
args.name: finalUrl

args.description: Why the capture failed, as the capture page reported it.
args.name: reason

args.description: Token of the capture ticket.
args.name: token

fields.description:
Records that a capture failed, deletes its uploads and returns the page as a new lookup would: its stored
thumbnail, if any, and no new ticket for the page and device for 24 hours. A REDIRECTED failure can instead
switch the page to its recordings; the result then carries a RECORDING capture ticket for sessions that may view
recordings. Requires an interactive session of the account the ticket was issued to.
fields.name: failPageThumbnail

args.description:
Ordered goal IDs from `goalRefList`, all accessible and belonging to `siteId`; matching uses the goals'
configured triggers.
args.name: goalSteps

args.description: Nonblank funnel display name.
args.name: name

args.description: Site ID from `sites`; all `goalSteps` goals must belong to it.
args.name: siteId

args.description: True to prepend a site-wide visit baseline before the ordered goal steps.
args.name: visitStep

fields.description:
Creates a saved funnel definition; use `funnelResult` to calculate its metrics without changing the definition.
Every goal must be accessible and belong to `siteId`; `visitStep` prepends a synthetic visit baseline. Returns
the saved funnel with goals in supplied order. Requires funnels edit access.
fields.name: funnelCreate

args.description: Saved funnel IDs from `funnelList`; duplicates and inaccessible IDs are skipped.
args.name: ids

fields.description:
Soft-deletes accessible funnels and their steps, returning only IDs actually deleted. Duplicate IDs are ignored
and inaccessible or already deleted IDs are skipped. Requires funnels edit access.
fields.name: funnelDelete

args.description:
Ordered goal IDs from `goalRefList`, all accessible and belonging to `siteId`; matching uses the goals'
configured triggers.
args.name: goalSteps

args.description: Saved funnel ID from `funnelList` or `funnelDetail`.
args.name: id

args.description: Nonblank funnel display name.
args.name: name

args.description: Site ID from `sites` that owns the funnel and every goal step.
args.name: siteId

args.description: True to prepend a site-wide visit baseline before the ordered goal steps.
args.name: visitStep

fields.description:
Replaces a saved funnel's name, visit baseline, and ordered goal steps; use `funnelEditName` to rename only.
Revalidates that goals are accessible and belong to the site, then replaces all steps transactionally. Missing
or inaccessible funnels return an error. Requires funnels edit access.
fields.name: funnelEdit

args.description: Saved funnel ID from `funnelList` or `funnelDetail`.
args.name: id

args.description: Nonblank funnel display name.
args.name: name

args.description: Site ID from `sites` that owns the funnel.
args.name: siteId

fields.description:
Renames a saved funnel and returns its definition without changing steps. Use `funnelEdit` to replace steps;
missing or inaccessible funnels return an error. Requires funnels edit access.
fields.name: funnelEditName

args.description: Site, name, and triggers of the new goal.
args.name: params

fields.description:
Creates a goal on a site and returns only its id; fetch the full goal with `goalDetail`. Every trigger filter is
validated before anything is saved, so one invalid filter creates nothing. On success the account's tracking
script is marked for regeneration and a page screenshot for the goal thumbnail is requested in the background.
Requires goal create access.
fields.name: goalCreate

args.description: Goal id from `goalRefList` or `goalCardList`.
args.name: id

fields.description:
Soft-deletes a non-deleted goal and returns its id; `goalRef` and `goalLinked` still resolve it afterward. Also
soft-deletes its triggers, detaches draft A/B tests that use it, deletes its other A/B tests and the funnels that
use it, removes its notifications, and marks the tracking script for regeneration. Requires goal edit access.
fields.name: goalDelete

args.description: Goal id and its complete new trigger list.
args.name: params

fields.description:
Replaces the trigger set and labels of a non-deleted goal, and its name when given, and returns only its id; use
`goalRename` to change only the name. Every filter is validated before anything is saved. Triggers sent with an
`id` are updated, triggers without one are created, and existing triggers left out are soft-deleted. On success
the tracking script is marked for regeneration and a new thumbnail screenshot is requested. Requires goal edit
access.
fields.name: goalEdit

args.description: Goal id from `goalRefList` or `goalCardList`.
args.name: id

args.description: New goal name; trimmed, then 1 to 255 characters.
args.name: name

fields.description:
Renames a non-deleted goal without touching its triggers and returns only its id. The name is trimmed and must
then be 1 to 255 characters. Requires goal edit access.
fields.name: goalRename

types.name: Playlist

types.description:
Custom playlist parameters for `savePlaylist`; the saved filter selects matching recordings dynamically rather than
storing recording ids.

inputFields.description:
JSON-encoded string. Envelope: `{"version":2,"operator":"AND","conditions":[...]}`, where `operator` is uppercase
`AND` or `OR` and `conditions` is a non-empty list of nested groups or leaves. A leaf has `criteria`, `comparison`
only when the criterion takes one, and `value` or `values` (plus `multiple_values` where required). Call
`recordingsCriteriaDefinition` for the criteria catalog; the `recordings-filter` skill is the long-form reference.
Required on create and update. Example:
{"version":2,"operator":"AND","conditions":[{"criteria":"date_range","value":{"special":"last 30 days"}}]}
inputFields.name: filter

inputFields.description: Positive custom playlist `id` from `playlistsList` for this site; omitted or null creates a playlist.
inputFields.name: id

inputFields.description: Non-blank name, at most 255 characters; required when creating and retained when omitted on update.
inputFields.name: name

and value rules, the criteria this account may use, and a valid example. Call it before writing an audience
definition and use each criterion's `discoveryQuery` to look up ids and values; the `audience-targeting` skill
carries the full JSON Schema. Requires audience view access.

page, so stop at an empty page. `BILLING_CHANGE`, `SNAPSHOTS_VIEWED`, and `INSTALL` also return matching app page
visits as `InternalUrlVisited` entries. Requires audit log view access.

Use it instead of repeated `goalRef` calls. Duplicate ids appear once, and unknown or inaccessible ids are left
out without an error. Requires goal view access.
fields.name: goalsByIds

args.description: Maximum returned font families, defaults to 50; must be at least 1 and is capped at 100.
args.name: limit

args.description:
Case-insensitive font-family substring; defaults to empty text for all cached families. Whitespace is
trimmed.
args.name: search

fields.description:
Returns font families from the cached Google Fonts catalog, optionally filtered by a case-insensitive
family-name substring. Results rank by popularity, then family name, with no cursor; this reads cached data
without refreshing it. Requires a logged-in session.
fields.name: googleFonts

args.description: Image UUID from `imageList`, `imageUpload` or `imageUploadUrls`.
args.name: id

args.description: Ignored; the image is looked up by `id` within the current account.
args.name: siteId

fields.description:
Returns one image visible to the current account, or an error if it is absent or inaccessible. Use
`imageList` to discover IDs; `siteId` is accepted but ignored. Requires a logged-in session.
fields.name: imageDetail

args.description: Opaque `nextPageCursor` from `imageList`; requests that pass a cursor currently fail, so omit it.
args.name: cursor

args.description:
Page-size options; supply `{limit: 10}` to bound results. Omitting this object leaves the list
unbounded.
args.name: filter

args.description: Site ID from `sites`; omit to include every accessible site.
args.name: siteId

args.description: Exact stored source label to include, for example `surveys`; defaults to `surveys`.
args.name: source

fields.description:
Returns the account's images with the given `source`, optionally for one site, in no guaranteed order. Use
`imageDetail` for one ID. Bound the list with `filter.limit`; passing `cursor` currently fails, and
`hasNextPage` is true only when exactly 50 images are returned. Requires a logged-in session.
fields.name: imageList

fields.description:
Returns a fresh JWT for the active account with its expiration time. The token expires two hours after
issuance. Requires authentication.
fields.name: interagentJwt

fields.description:
Returns supported language codes and display names for language conditions. Use these codes for audience
filters; this static list does not vary by account or locale. Requires a logged-in session.
fields.name: languages

fields.description:
Returns the signed-in viewer profile, active account settings, subscriptions, and accessible accounts.
Profile fields describe the viewer, while `userId` identifies the active account and `guestId` identifies
the viewer. Use `capabilities` for product permissions rather than `features`. Requires authentication.
fields.name: me

args.description: Opaque `nextPageCursor` from `notificationsList`; omit for the first page.
args.name: cursor

args.description: Page size from 1 to 200; defaults to 25.
args.name: limit

args.description: Sort descriptor; defaults to creation time descending.
args.name: order

args.description: Only return rules for this resource type; combine with `resourceId` to target one resource.
args.name: resource

args.description: Resource id as a string: goal id from `goalCardList`, survey id from `addonList`, or site id from `sites`.
args.name: resourceId

args.description:
Substring match on goal or survey name, `Errors on <site name>`, resource type, channel type, or destination;
`*` matches any characters.
args.name: search

args.description: Site id from `sites`; omit to include all sites visible to the caller.
args.name: siteId

args.description: Optional delivery channel type filter.
args.name: type

fields.description:
Returns the account's notification rules for goal conversions, survey responses, and site errors, newest first by
default, skipping deleted rules and sites the caller cannot access. Page by passing `nextPageCursor` back as
`cursor`; `hasNextPage` only means this page was full. Requires notifications navigation access.
fields.name: notificationsList

fields.description:
Returns a container for tracking settings; select nested fields to retrieve values. Use `me.settings` for
saved account preferences. The IP and cookie-blocking fields require tracking options edit access.
fields.name: options

args.description: Diagnostic text written to server logs; the successful response is null.
args.name: message

fields.description:
Writes a page camera diagnostic message with the current user agent and user ID, returning null on success.
Use for capture diagnostics; it does not return snapshot data. Requires snapshot create access.
fields.name: pageCameraDebug

args.description: Lowercase `desktop`, `phone` or `tablet`; required with `sourceUrl` when `snapshotId` is omitted.
args.name: device

args.description:
Editable snapshot ID from `pageCameraSnapshots` or `snapshotsList`; when present, takes precedence
over `sourceUrl` and `device`.
args.name: snapshotId

args.description: Absolute HTTP or HTTPS page URL; required with `device` when `snapshotId` is omitted.
args.name: sourceUrl

fields.description:
Returns upload POST targets valid for 10 minutes for user-captured page screenshots and element data. An
editable `snapshotId` takes precedence and returns `elements`; otherwise supply an HTTP(S) `sourceUrl` and
lowercase device to obtain `fingerprints`. Use `pageCameraSetScreenshotStatus` after uploading an existing
capture. Requires snapshot edit access.
fields.name: pageCameraGetUploadPolicy

fields.description:
Returns session and quota state for the page camera capture client; an unauthenticated call fails rather
than returning `loggedIn: false`. Use before selecting a capture flow, and use `checkSnapshotsQuota` for a
numeric overage estimate. Requires a logged-in session.
fields.name: pageCameraIsLoggedIn

fields.description:
Returns accessible manual snapshots that use user-uploaded screenshots and element data; read-only sessions
get an empty list. The list is unpaginated with no guaranteed order; use `snapshotsList` to browse both
automatic and manual snapshots. Requires snapshot view access.
fields.name: pageCameraSnapshots

args.description: Editor UUID from `pageEditorCreatePage` or `pageEditorLatest`.
args.name: editorId

Returns the requested capabilities of the account that owns an editor rather than the caller's. Returns null when
the editor does not exist or has no owner yet; use `capabilities` for the caller's own account. Requires a page
editor token for the editor, or a logged-in user who owns the editor or can edit the site of one of its pages.
fields.name: pageEditorCapabilities

args.description: Device for the live script check when installation is not already known.
args.name: device

args.description: Page UUID from `pageEditorCreatePage` or `pageEditorGetEditor`.
args.name: pageId

fields.description:
Reports whether the Crazy Egg script is installed for the site of a page editor page. Returns `installed: true`
when the site is already marked installed; otherwise runs a live script check of the page URL for `device`.
Requires page editor navigation access.
fields.name: pageEditorCheckScript

args.description: Editor UUID from `pageEditorCreatePage` or `pageEditorLatest`.
args.name: editorId

args.description: Site hostname such as `www.example.com`; settings are stored per registrable domain (`example.com`).
args.name: site

fields.description:
Returns an editor's brand guideline settings for one site as a JSON-encoded object with `checks`, `voices`,
`voiceTestContent`, and `profile`. Built-in checks and voices replace saved entries with the same `id` and are added
when missing, so a site with nothing saved still returns Crazy Egg defaults. Use `pageEditorSaveBrandGuidelines` to
replace the settings. Requires a page editor token for the editor, or a logged-in user who owns the editor or can
edit the site.
fields.name: pageEditorGetBrandGuidelines

args.description: Editor UUID from `pageEditorCreatePage` or `pageEditorLatest`.
args.name: editorId

fields.description:
Returns an editor with its pages and saved versions, or null when the editor does not exist. Updates the editor's
last-opened time and assigns an unowned editor to the current account when the caller is signed in. Requires a page
editor token or a logged-in user.
fields.name: pageEditorGetEditor

fields.description:
Returns the UUID of the current account's editor with the most recently published version, or of the most recently
opened editor when none has published versions. Returns null when the account has no editors; load the editor with
`pageEditorGetEditor`. Requires page editor navigation access.
fields.name: pageEditorLatest

args.description: Registrable site domain, such as `example.com`.
args.name: domain

args.name: ownerId

args.name: userId

`domain`. When the user is not in the owner's account only `accountExists: false` is set. Requires page editor
navigation access.
fields.name: pageEditorListPermissions

args.description: Tracked page ID from `pageSpeedPages` or `pageSpeedPageCreate`; not a run ID.
args.name: id

fields.description:
Returns one non-deleted tracked page and its latest desktop and phone runs. Use `pageSpeedRuns` for capture
history or `pageSpeedPages` for a site's pages. Missing or inaccessible pages return an error. Requires page
speed view access.
fields.name: pageSpeedPage

args.description: Site ID from `sites`; the caller must be able to edit the site.
args.name: siteId

args.description: From 1 to 25 page URLs; whitespace is trimmed and a missing HTTP scheme is added.
args.name: urls

fields.description:
Checks which supplied URLs already have a non-deleted tracked page for an editable site. Returns one row per
input in input order; `pageId` is null when unmatched. Trims whitespace and adds a missing HTTP scheme before
exact URL matching; this does not create pages. Requires page speed edit access.
fields.name: pageSpeedPageDuplicates

args.description: Site ID from `sites`; the caller must have access to the site.
args.name: siteId

descending, with unscheduled pages last. Includes each page's latest desktop and phone runs; use `pageSpeedRuns`
for full history. There is no pagination. Requires page speed view access.
fields.name: pageSpeedPages

args.description: Run ID from `pageSpeedRuns` or a page's `latestRuns`; not the tracked page ID.
args.name: pageSpeedRunId

fields.description:
Returns interpreted metrics and actionable recommendations for an accessible run. Use `pageSpeedRunAudits` for
passed, warning, failed, and errored audit rows. Missing raw results yield unscored metrics and empty
recommendations; a missing run returns an error. Requires page speed view access.
fields.name: pageSpeedRunAnalysis

args.description: Run ID from `pageSpeedRuns` or a page's `latestRuns`; not the tracked page ID.
args.name: pageSpeedRunId

fields.description:
Returns categorized audit rows for an accessible run, omitting manual and not-applicable audits and performance
metric rows. Audits sort failed, error, warning, informative warning, then passed; detail lists are capped at
five items. Use `pageSpeedRunAnalysis` for metrics and recommendations. A missing run returns an error. Requires
page speed view access.
fields.name: pageSpeedRunAudits

args.description: Tracked page ID from `pageSpeedPages`; not a run ID.
args.name: pageSpeedPageId

fields.description:
Returns all captured runs for one non-deleted tracked page, ordered by scheduled time then ID descending, with
unscheduled runs last. Use `pageSpeedRunAnalysis` for interpreted metrics or `pageSpeedRunAudits` for audit
details. Missing or inaccessible pages return an error. Requires page speed view access.
fields.name: pageSpeedRuns

args.description: Maximum suggestions, default 15; values are clamped to 1 through 50.
args.name: limit

args.description: Site ID from `sites`; the caller must be able to edit the site.
args.name: siteId

request fresh page discovery when data is missing; the response includes status and retry timing for polling.
Use `pageSpeedPages` for registered pages. Requires page speed edit access and an editable site.
fields.name: pageSpeedSuggestedPages

args.description: Pages to look up.
args.name: requests

args.description: Site whose pages to look up.
args.name: siteId

fields.description:
Returns one preview per requested page of a site, in request order. URLs are canonicalized on the server.
Sources: the Spider screenshot (the site's private one only with Recordings-view access), the site's browser
capture of the page, then the newest processed Snapshot thumbnail for the device. Otherwise an interactive
session gets status CAPTURE with a capture ticket for pages on the site's domain, unless a capture of the page
failed in the last 24 hours. Image URLs are presigned and expire after 15 minutes. Requires access to the site;
accepts at most 100 requests.
fields.name: pageThumbnails

args.description:
Billing-history entry ID from `paymentTransactionList`; the synthetic account-creation ID 0 has no
detail record.
args.name: id

fields.description:
Returns one stored billing-history entry for the active account without contacting the payment provider.
Use an ID from `paymentTransactionList`; a missing entry returns an error rather than null. Requires
billing navigation access.
fields.name: paymentTransaction

args.description:
Opaque `nextPageCursor` from `paymentTransactionList`; omit for the first page. It excludes every ID
already returned.
args.name: cursor

args.description: Page size from 1 to 200; defaults to 50.
args.name: limit

args.description:
Billing history ordering; defaults to `CREATED_AT` ascending. Keep the same order across cursor
requests.
args.name: order

Returns stored billing history, including a synthetic account-creation row, without contacting the payment
provider. Defaults to creation time ascending; the cursor excludes IDs already returned, and a full page
may still be the last page. Use `paymentTransaction` for one history ID. Requires billing navigation
access.
fields.name: paymentTransactionList

args.description: Site id from `sites`; the site must be accessible to the current viewer.
args.name: site

Filter version; 2 is the only supported version and is used when omitted, null, 0, or negative. Other values
return an error.
args.name: version

fields.description:
Returns recommended playlists together with the site's custom playlists, sorted case-insensitively by name, with
each filter in the requested version. Custom playlists whose stored filter fails validation are omitted. Use
`playlistsMostRecent` for the current user's usage order. Requires recordings view access.
fields.name: playlistsList

args.description:
Result limit from 1 to 100; omitted, null, or out-of-range values use 5. May return fewer when no more
recommendations exist.
args.name: limit

args.description: Site id from `sites`; the site must be accessible to the current viewer.
args.name: site

fields.description:
Returns the current viewer's recently used playlists for a site, ordered by last use descending. Backfills with
unused recommended playlists when history is shorter than `limit`; use `playlistsList` for filters and the complete
catalog. Requires recordings view access.
fields.name: playlistsMostRecent

args.description:
Stripe price ID from `pricingGrid` or a tier `stripeId` from `tieredPricingPlans`; not the numeric
payment plan ID.
args.name: planPriceId

fields.description:
Previews a plan change through Stripe without applying it. A trial change can end the trial and charge
immediately; lower-price changes or delayed renewals can defer billing. When `requiresCheckout` is true,
amounts are null; otherwise pass the returned `prorationDate` to `updateSubscriptionItems` when present.
Requires authentication.
fields.name: previewSubscriptionUpdate

fields.description:
Returns the pricing presentation selected from the active account plan and payment provider.
`ANALYTICS_GROWTH` includes plan cards and comparison data; `LEGACY` returns empty lists, so use
`pricingGrid`. Requires authentication.
fields.name: pricingExperience

fields.description:
Returns account-specific plans, interval prices, and available billing intervals for the legacy plan
picker. Use `pricingExperience` to select the appropriate pricing presentation and `tieredPricingPlans`
for tier price IDs. Requires authentication.
fields.name: pricingGrid

args.description:
Public `hashedId` from `recordingsList` or `recording_id` from `recordingsDataForAi`; numeric `id` is not
accepted.
args.name: hashedId

Looks up one recording by `hashedId` and returns it with `skipRecordingCursor`, which can be passed as `cursor` to
`recordingsList` to exclude this recording. Use `recordingsList` to discover ids. A missing or inaccessible
recording returns an error, as does one whose owner lacks an active recordings subscription. Requires recordings
view access; shared-link sessions are allowed.
fields.name: recording

args.description:
JSON-encoded string. Envelope: `{"version":2,"operator":"AND","conditions":[...]}`, where `operator` is
uppercase `AND` or `OR` and `conditions` is a non-empty list of nested groups or leaves. A leaf has `criteria`,
`comparison` only when the criterion takes one, and `value` or `values` (plus `multiple_values` where required).
Call `recordingsCriteriaDefinition` for the criteria catalog; the `recordings-filter` skill is the long-form
reference. Example:
{"version":2,"operator":"AND","conditions":[{"criteria":"date_range","value":{"special":"last 30 days"}}]}
args.name: filters

args.description: Site id from `sites`; the site must be accessible to the current viewer.
args.name: site

fields.description:
Returns the total recordings matching a site and filter, or null on plans where recording totals are not computed.
Use this for totals instead of counting a page or the capped `recordingsDataForAi` sample. Requires recordings
view access.

args.description:
Filter version; 2 is the only supported version and is used when omitted, null, 0, or negative. Other values
return an error.
args.name: version

fields.description:
Returns a JSON-encoded object `{"version":2,"definitions":[...]}`, the authoritative criteria catalog for recordings
`filters`. Each definition gives its `criteria` key, `use_comparison` and `allowed_comparisons`,
`use_multiple_values` (send `values` instead of `value`), `multiple_values_options`, `compose_value` (`value` is an
object keyed by field name), and `fields` with types, options, and validations. Requires recordings view access;
shared-link sessions are allowed.

args.description: Site id from `sites`; the site must be accessible to the current viewer.

`goal_conversion_count`, `final_worth` and `max_worth` (scaled by 10,000), and their `currency`. Use

version 2 as the only version, this returns the validated filter re-encoded, so it can check a payload before saving

with an `originalUrl` (except Heatmap and Page Speed links), otherwise `RESOURCE` with metadata and an expiring

owner is gone, or the owner's subscription no longer covers it. Successful lookups count as a view.

Returns the public share link for a resource the caller can access, creating an enabled link when none exists. An
existing link is returned as is, even when disabled and regardless of `originalUrl`; use `sharedUrls` and the
share-link mutations to manage links. Requires sharing create access.

`sharedUrl` to get or create the link for one resource. Requires sharing manage access.

and `siteAssetRevisions` for history. Returns an error when site assets are not enabled for the account.

args.description:
At most 200 URLs to leave out before the limit applies, for example pages
the user already added. Each is canonicalized like Spider's page URLs
(case of scheme and host, default port, trailing slash, fragment, tracking
parameters) and also excludes its `http` and `https` forms with and
without one leading `www.`. An entry without a scheme (`example.com/pricing`)
is read as `http://`; a relative one (`/pricing`) is ignored.
args.name: excludeUrls

args.description: Maximum number of pages, default 25. Values outside 1 to 50 are clamped to that range.
args.name: limit

args.description: Only confidently classified pages of this type. Quick-crawl pages are unclassified and never match.
args.name: pageType

args.description:
Autocomplete text, at most 200 characters, matched case-insensitively
against the URL and the page title. Every word must match; words of 4 or
more letters also match with a typo. A path (`/pricing`) or a URL with a
host (`example.com/pricing`) matches that path and the pages under it.
args.name: query

args.description: Site ID from `sites`.
args.name: siteId

fields.description:
Returns pages of the Site's Spider site map and a `status` saying whether asking again will return more.
Without `query` or `pageType` these are suggested pages, most important first; pass pages the user already
added in `excludeUrls` to get the next ones. With `query` this is URL and title autocomplete, best match
first: an exact path segment before a word or substring of the path, the path before the title,
tolerating typos; importance only orders pages that match equally well. The first
request for an empty map runs a quick crawl (up to about 10 seconds), returns the pages the Site's
Recordings and Web Analytics already know, and queues a full crawl and their import, so the answer is
partial: while `PENDING`, repeat every 10 to 30 seconds, backing off, until `READY`; on `UNAVAILABLE`,
retry after `retryAfterS` or stop when it is null. Pages seen only in Recordings, Web Analytics or Google
Analytics imports are returned only to users who may view Recordings. Requires site access.
fields.name: siteMapPages

fields.description:

retrieve add-ons for a selected site. Requires survey view access or CTA view access.

Requires goals view access.

for the general site list; counts may be null when only presence is checked. Requires recordings view

sites for general settings or site for one ID. Requires snapshots view access.
